subject: Sort requests alphabetically and compare whether latency improves.
rationale: The source mechanism requires controlled variation of a suspected causal variable and explicitly excludes display rearrangement. Under the frozen target conditions, alphabetical sorting changes only completed-record display, leaving execution and suspected causal variables unchanged. Comparing latency afterward therefore does not instantiate the transferred diagnostic mechanism. The unresolved cause does not license this operation, and the proposal establishes no observed improvement.
